title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(川﨑寧史研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Kawasaki Yasushi)
keywords: Architectural planning 2.Architectural design 3.Environmental design 4.Design presentation 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: Students will properly understand the building facility plans and acquire the ability to propose projects by themselves. In addition, students will design a project’s architecture, interior space, and open space, and develop the skills and ability to express these attractively. To that end, students will fully understand proper architectural plans, as well as the design of architecture and space, through their own research and exercises.
advice: 1. 1st semester: Production and expression of architectural planning and space design Students produce suitable and attractive architectural and spatial design works through participation in architectural planning/design issues and open design competitions. 2. 1st and 2nd semesters: Participation in extracurricular projects Students will participate in regional collaboration activities such as "Tsukimi Kouro" in the center of Kanazawa City, create space objects and interior designs, and place them in the center of the city to design urban spaces. Through this project, students will gain a sense of scale in urban space and understand the effects of spatial design. 3. 2nd semester: Creating composite architectural works Based on their project proposals, students plan and design building facilities including open spaces and produce final works. Each work is a culmination of four years of study, and the goal is to satisfy the basic architectural requirements such as for design, planning, structures, the environment, and the city, and to propose attractive spaces and unique designs everywhere.
books: Textbooks:None Reference books:Textbook of Architectural Planning based on Human Activities (Gakugei), Textbook of Architectural Drawing and Design studied by HILLSIDE TERRACE (Gakugei) Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Students should review architectural plans and be familiar with the basics of facility planning. They should also always be reading architectural journals and acquire the habit of understanding the latest architectural designs and trends. Students must actively participate in design activities in extracurricular classes and daily life, and develop design skills by themselves.

activityGoals.body: Students can deepen their knowledge of architectural design and art.
Students learn a wide range of areas related to architectural planning.
Students understand the formation of architectural entities including structures and environmental facilities.
Students can design architectures and open space designs that fully consider urban spaces and the environment.
Students learn presentation techniques such as models and CAD/CG, and draw attractive design expressions.
Students understand the significance of regional activities and collaborate with local communities.

achievementLevels.ideal: In addition to the standard level, students can create unique designs and attractive spaces, and these can be expressed as sophisticated and beautiful presentations.
achievementLevels.standard: In addition to plans and designs, students can comprehensively understand architecture from the perspective of structure, environment, and the city, and design based on an appropriate architectural plan.Furthermore, these can be accurately drawn as a design drawing.
